title: Closing-Service Fee Exclusion by Closing Method, Neighborhood Access Grant
content:
**Closing operations note — Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant**

The closing-service exclusion follows the closing method of the file's closing under the Closing and Funding engagement, because a travelling or remote signing is a convenience the borrower chose. It is measured on the closing-service fees charged on that closing — its closing-method, after-hours signing and courier fees — less any of them reversed.

- On a Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing or Larkspur Mail-Away Closing, the whole of the closing-service fees charged on that closing (its closing-method, after-hours signing and courier fees), less any of them reversed, is excluded.
- On a Larkspur Hybrid eClosing or Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing, half (50 percent) of those fees, rounded to the cent, is excluded.
- On any other closing method, nothing is excluded.

In finding the grant's unpaid closing costs, the closing-service exclusion is subtracted from the payable closing costs together with the concessions, the charges paid before closing and the closing-cost entries already booked, before the floor at zero.

| Closing method | Share of the net closing-service fees excluded |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing | the whole |
| Larkspur Mail-Away Closing | the whole |
| Larkspur Hybrid eClosing | half, rounded to the cent |
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | half, rounded to the cent |
| any other method, such as a Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing | nothing |

### Worked example (hypothetical fee entries)

A closing carries a closing-method fee of 250.00, an after-hours signing fee of 75.00 and a courier fee of 45.00, and the courier fee was later reversed: net closing-service fees 325.00. On a Larkspur Mail-Away Closing the exclusion is 325.00; on a Larkspur Hybrid eClosing it is 162.50; on a Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing it is 0.00. A fee of any other kind charged on the closing is not a closing-service fee for this measure.
